User.title: User
User.description: Represents an authenticated user account in the system, primarily linking to external authentication (Firebase Auth). Passwords and other sensitive authentication data are managed by Firebase Auth and not stored here.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, typically the Firebase Authentication User ID (UID).

email.description: The user's primary email address, obtained from the authentication system.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account's data was last updated.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a specific viewing profile associated with a user account, allowing for multiple personalized experiences per user (e.g., 'Kids', 'Dad's Profile').

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User this profile belongs to. (Relationship: User 1:N UserProfile)

name.description: The display name for the user profile (e.g., 'John's Profile', 'Kids').

avatarUrl.description: URL to the avatar image used for this profile.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Content.title: Content
Content.description: Represents a single piece of media content such as a movie or TV show episode, including all its metadata and media URLs.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Content entity.

title.description: The main title of the content (e.g., 'Replicant Dawn').

description.description: A brief summary or synopsis of the content.

tagline.description: A short, catchy phrase or slogan for the content, often used in hero sections.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to the primary poster or thumbnail image for the content, typically hosted in Firebase Storage.

videoUrl.description: URL to the main video file for streaming the content, typically hosted in Firebase Storage.

trailerUrl.description: URL to a short, muted video preview or trailer for the content, used for interactive previews.

durationMinutes.description: The total duration of the content in minutes.

releaseDate.description: The date when the content was originally released.

imdbRating.description: The IMDb rating for the content, on a scale of 0 to 10.

genreIds.description: References to the Genres this content belongs to. (Relationship: Content N:N Genre)

directorIds.description: References to the People who directed this content. (Relationship: Content N:N Person)

castIds.description: References to the People who are part of the cast for this content. (Relationship: Content N:N Person)

isFeatured.description: A boolean indicating if the content should be prominently featured, for example, in the hero section.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the content metadata was created or uploaded.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the content metadata was last updated.

Genre.title: Genre
Genre.description: Represents a specific classification or type of content (e.g., 'Action', 'Sci-Fi'), used for filtering and organization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Genre entity.

description.description: A brief description of the genre.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the genre was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the genre was last updated.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a curated list or browsing section for content (e.g., 'Trending', 'Top Picks', 'New Releases'), distinct from genre classifications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

name.description: The name of the category (e.g., 'Trending', 'Top Picks').

description.description: A brief description of the category.

contentIds.description: References to the Content items included in this curated category. (Relationship: Category N:N Content)

order.description: A numerical value to determine the display order of categories in the UI.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the category was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the category was last updated.

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: Represents a content item that a specific user profile has added to their personal watchlist for later viewing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WatchlistItem entity.

userProfileId.description: Reference to the UserProfile that owns this watchlist item. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N WatchlistItem)

contentId.description: Reference to the Content item that is on the watchlist. (Relationship: Content 1:N WatchlistItem)

addedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the content was added to the watchlist.

ContinueWatchingItem.title: ContinueWatchingItem
ContinueWatchingItem.description: Tracks the playback progress for a specific content item by a user profile, enabling seamless resume playback functionality across devices.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ContinueWatchingItem entity.

userProfileId.description: Reference to the UserProfile whose playback progress is being tracked. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ContinueWatchingItem)

contentId.description: Reference to the Content item being watched. (Relationship: Content 1:N ContinueWatchingItem)

playbackPositionSeconds.description: The last recorded playback position in seconds for the content, allowing playback to resume from this point.

lastWatchedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the content was last watched and its progress was updated.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: Represents an individual involved in content production, such as an actor or director, with their biographical details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Person entity.

name.description: The full name of the person (e.g., 'Tom Cruise', 'Steven Spielberg').

bio.description: A short biographical description of the person.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to an image or photo of the person.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the person's record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the person's record was last updated.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores individual viewing profiles associated with a user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent user.

params.name: userProfileId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific user profile.
